title: Invalid streamed tool JSON silently becomes empty tool args
wanted_capability: When an Anthropic-compatible provider streams invalid `input_json_delta` for a tool call, the harness should fail closed or surface a parse error instead of parsing it as `{}` and letting terminal structured outputs silently lose data.
missing_primitive: strict tool input JSON parse failure reporting
fallback_used: Used the textual retrospective and raw JSONL deltas to recover the probe feedback.
notes: Observed on the DeepSeek isolate probe retrospective: the provider streamed unquoted string values in `final_result` input_json_delta; `parse_tool_input` returned `{}`. The turn completed successfully with result `{}`, hiding the schema failure.
